text:
Ravi: Hey folks, quick newbie question: what's the right place to ask for (a) VPN, (b) badge, (c) repo access, (d) billing/project GCP perms, and (e) how to silence onboarding DMs? Don't want to flood channels.
IT Desk: Welcome Ravi! TL;DR: VPN -> #help (put 'vpn' in the subject), badge -> #people-ops (name + office), repo access -> Access Form then ping @DevEx, billing/GCP -> #eng-infra with project id & role. For urgent issues DM me directly.
Ravi: Cool. If the request is only relevant to my squad (e.g., a test repo), should I post in #eng-runtime or the global channels?
DevEx: Start in your team channel (e.g., #eng-runtime) for team-scoped asks. If infra needs to act, create the Access Form and paste the ticket link in your thread so infra can triage.
Jo: Note on etiquette: use threads for follow-ups, react with :eyes:/:thumbsup: for quick ack, avoid @channel/@here unless it's an outage or office-wide announcement.
OnboardBot: Commands:
`/onboard prefs` -> DM to set cadence
`/onboard pause 7d` -> pause messages for 7 days
`/onboard stop` -> unsubscribe from onboarding DMs
Click "Manage" in the welcome DM to get a GUI.
Ravi: Thanks! Also, where to post long logs? Don't want to paste huge dumps.
IT Desk: Put big logs in a Gist or Google Drive and share the link with a 1-line summary in your thread. For small snippets, use triple-backticks:
```
Error: permission denied cloning repo
steps: tried ssh, tried https
```
Post that in #eng-infra and tag oncall if blocking.
Lena (People Ops): Badge pickup note: include full legal name and office location in #people-ops. If you're remote and need a badge shipped, DM People Ops with shipping address and start date. Processing is ~2 business days.
Ravi: Perfect, thanks everyone! One last: casual invites go in #lunch-plans or #random?
Jo: #lunch-plans for food meetups, #random for social/memes. Both fine.
Ravi: Great, appreciate the map :wave:
